parsing_traps: Bugis+ and Bukit Panjang Plaza are reported as a combined 'Other Assets' line for gross revenue (S$65.7m) and committed occupancy (99.9%) on both their own property pages and the Financial Review table; per-property values set to null.

CapitaSpring gross revenue conflict: Financial Review (page 25) shows S$37.7m (consolidated, only from 26 Aug 2025 acquisition of remaining 55%), while the property page (page 52) shows S$72.7m (full-year, 100% basis, including serviced residence up to divestment 30 May 2025). The page-25 figure was used so property revenues reconcile to the audited total.

Mixed valuation/revenue bases across properties: ION Orchard page discloses valuation on 100% basis (S$3,710.4m) but gross revenue on 50% basis (S$130.8m); 101-103 Miller Street page discloses both valuation and revenue on 50% basis; CapitaSky on 100% basis with 70% ownership; Germany assets on 100% basis with 94.9% ownership. Portfolio Valuation table (page 23) uses proportionate-interest values for ION (1,855.2), CapitaSky (887.6), Gallileo (519.7), MAC (303.5), Miller (271.1).

Three different portfolio-value figures exist: page 23/24 grand total S$27,397.5m (proportionate), balance-sheet investment properties S$25,601.6m carrying value (consolidated only, excludes ION JV, includes 100% of Germany assets), plus Bukit Panjang Plaza S$390.9m reclassified to assets held for sale.

Distributable income: highlights report S$860.9m, but Distribution Statement (page 108) shows S$869,957k generated in the year; difference is S$6.9m + S$2.2m retained from CapitaLand China Trust and Sentral REIT distributions (page 26). 860.9 used as net_distributable_income.

Note 21 'Gross rental income' (S$1,514.2m) is not split between base rent and turnover rent; contingent rents of S$84.4m are disclosed separately in the Portfolio Statement notes (page 110), so income_components uses 'rental_income' rather than 'base_rental'.

Tenure label issues: IMM Building is '30 + 30 years' (Portfolio Statement normalises to 60 years); Asia Square Tower 2 leasehold applies to 'land lot only'; 66 Goulburn Street tenure printed as 'expiring 16 August 2116' on property page but 'Term of Lease 111 - 125 years' in the audited Portfolio Statement.

Top-10-tenant and trade-mix percentages are based on monthly GRI for December 2025 excluding GTO, on CICT's proportionate interests - not on FY gross revenue; ECB is flagged as a future top-10 tenant once Gallileo handover completes.
Number of unitholders (91,421) is as at 27 February 2026, not as at FY end.

Bedok Mall, Westgate, Asia Square Tower 2, CapitaGreen, CapitaSky, ION Orchard, Gallileo, MAC, 66 Goulburn, 100 Arthur disclose 'Agreed Property Value' rather than 'Purchase Price'; both treated as acquisition price in property_transactions with notes.
ION Orchard property page provides no major-tenant list and no trade mix table (only ~280 tenants, ~98% occupancy approximations).
